payload.description: A dense urban area surrounds a large, irregular cleared construction parcel. The parcel contains a prominent light-toned near-circular, bilaterally symmetric arrangement of curved paths or paved bands divided by a long north-south central strip. Several rectangular pads, small structures, graded earth areas, and linear corridors are distributed within the site. Broad roads and intersections border the parcel, while adjacent blocks contain repetitive multi-story buildings, additional construction areas, and a small athletic track or court. No berms, revetments, or clearly distinguishable specialized equipment are visible at this resolution.

site.name: the old Rawalpindi-area site
site.signature_geometry: perimeter berm and access road configuration largely unchanged from the 2024-11 baseline; two of the hardstand pads; cleared laydown area; northern or southern pad clusters; fenced compound
site.source_quote:
The site in question — referred to in prior open reporting simply as "the old Rawalpindi-area site" near the port road turnoff, not the garrison itself — was tasked for revisit collection this cycle following unconfirmed claims circulating on regional defense forums of a battery relocation.

The area consistent with the suspected forward site shows the previously noted perimeter berm and access road configuration largely unchanged from the 2024-11 baseline. Vegetation growth along the eastern edge has advanced somewhat and now partially shadows two of the hardstand pads noted in earlier passes.

Current imagery is assessed as a negative TEL presence observation for the pass window noted.

payload.source_quote: Current imagery is assessed as a negative TEL presence observation for the pass window noted. This does not preclude the possibility of dispersal, maintenance rotation to an unobserved facility, or a collection-timing gap relative to the forum claim referenced in Section 4.
